content: Ntsür awà kan'too u ngyäl

Apan, mɛ kàmɛn ntsür mwɛy kan'too u ngyäl a kölàköl. Wa kàkäl anà mbwaŋ, mbwaŋ kwem anà in'tswe, in'tswe nsambwaar. Udu a mbwaŋ mwɛy mwɛy, wa kàbwäär mpà a imwol, anà udu a in'tswe awa byàkäl anà ikɔb mubɛy Nzam.

Ntsür awà kàmɛn mɛ kàkäl asànaa nkwe, an'bwar awa màkäl asànaa an'bwar a ntsür awàbàfàbel naa urs anà mun awa asànaa mun a ntaamà. Dalàgɔ kun'pɛ ngwal ande, imwol ande anà ikɔ̈b akölàköl.
Umwɛy uboo a in'tswe kàmɛnà asànaa wàŋàyɔɔ tsütsü mukwà, wɛɛ iwà akin kyàkyer akwà. Mɛɛn manswà màkäl mukun'täŋ anà mukun'lab.
Baar bàbulà mukömà dalàgɔ, ntɔn la làpɛ ikɔ̈b akà ntsür. Ba bàkömà sye ntsür, mutɛn naa: « Nà awà asànaa ntsür? Nà kan'kwo munwan anà wa? »
Ntsür kàwɛl ikɔ̈b mutɛn ndaa a uyɔl anà yàbɛy Nzam anà ikɔ̈b musal ngɔn an'kwem an'nà aŋiyweel.
Wa kàsɛmà mubɛy Nzam, mubɛy ikɔb ande, ikal ufàbwaay nde anà baar bàfàkal u du.
Wa kàwɛl mbwo munwan anà aŋin'kyɛɛl anà muwal iböŋ udu a ba. Bun'pɛ sye ikɔ̈b udu a mbil yanswà, un'sɛŋ wanswà, ndaa yanswà anà nsi yanswà.
Baar a mɛɛn banswà bàkyer asun'kömà, baar banswà mpa kyàkäl ikɔb aba kyàŋàsɔn, sɛmà nkyeer a mɛɛn, uboo a un'kaan a mɔ̈ɔ̈, un'kaan a un'to a un'kɔk awà bàdwä.
« Wɛy mbuur awe anà an'tsü uwem!
Isàkal yan'lɔm naa mbuur akyà isɔ, nde asàkyà isɔ. Isàkal yan'lɔm naa mbuur bàkyer un'dwa a kɔm, nde bàsun'dwa a kɔm. Lalà là taaŋ a muküünà anà là làkwikilà a aŋin'kyɛɛl. »
Ntsür kan'too u mɛɛn
Apan mɛ kàmɛn ntsür asin wàmutoo u mɛɛn. Wa kàkäl anà mbwaŋ, mbwaŋ yweel asànaa un'to a un'kɔk, wɛɛ wa kàtɛɛnà asànaa dalàgɔ.
Wa asyäälà ikɔ̈b kyanswà kyà ntsür wàtàtwɛb u mii a wa. Wa akasiinà mɛɛn anà baar ama a ngwal mukömà ntsür wàtàtwɛb awà kyàkü iwà akwà kyàlun'dwa.
Ntsür wàyweel awà wàmukyer idiim a kölàköl, itàkal mutyey mbaa fà du tii u mɛɛn, u mii a baar banswà.
Wa afàbwiy baar a mɛɛn ndwaŋ u mbwo a idiim bun'pɛ mbwo mukyer u mii a ntsür wàtàtwɛb. Wa afàsiinà baar a mɛɛn mukyer itɛk ntɔn ibyääl a ntsür awà bàyɔ̈ɔ̈l a kɔm anà kàwü mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Ntsür wàyweel kàwɛl ikɔ̈b mupà un'swey akà itɛk a ntsür wàtàtwɛb, ntɔn kya isi ndaa anà idwä baar bàtön mukun'kömà.
Ntsür wàmusiinà baar banswà a ngwal, bibaar anà baar baar, aŋin'naaŋ anà aŋàlàmbwà, asɔ anà baar a nsaay, muwal idiim mwɛy udu a kɔɔ ibaal itàkal u ntabwey.
Akà mbuur mwɛy kàlàkwo anki musom itàkal muyälà yàlàkal naa nde idiim aki kyatɛy, iswaŋà naa ikɔb a ntsür itàkal un'tal a ikɔb awa.
Apà, ilɔɔmà an'yeerà. Mbuur awe anà un'yɛnà kan'kwo uyilà un'tal a ntsür, ntɔn un'tal awà kan'kwo a ikɔb a baal mwɛy. Un'tal ande wa wà nkam syaam a an'kwem an'syaam aŋisyaam.
